title: The Final Portrait
author: Mirabel Amberdale
blurb: Silas Brightwater, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
